title: INTERPLANE Intent: tool_request
description: Canonical model intent produced by Lenshift. Expresses what a model asked for. Carries no authority.

request_id.description: Unique per trace. Duplicates are rejected.

arguments.description: Always a JSON object. Non-object arguments are a malformed_tool_call.

source_call_id.description: The dialect-native call id if the dialect has one (e.g. OpenAI tool_call.id).

source_digest.description: SHA-256 of the original dialect-native representation. Raw text is not persisted by default.

raw_name.description: Exactly what the model emitted as the tool name before canonicalization.

coercion.description: How untyped dialect values were typed.

inputs.description: input_ids visible to the model when it produced the turn.

floor.description: Least trusted level among those inputs. Order: trusted_runtime > user_supplied > workspace_untrusted > external_untrusted; unknown counts as external_untrusted.

exposure.description: Computed by the pipeline from its own ledger. A value arriving inside a model-produced or admitted envelope is discarded and recomputed, never read.
